items.source: Alias for expression(); only intended to be used if reason() and loadContext() are not specified.
items.translation: `expression()` 的别名；仅当未指定 `reason()` 和 `loadContext()` 时才打算使用。

items.source: If the expression evaluates to Boolean.TRUE or a String equal to "true" (ignoring case), the test will be disabled.
items.translation: 如果表达式求值为 `Boolean.TRUE` 或等于 `String` 的字符串（不区分大小写）`"true"`，则测试将被禁用。

items.source: Note, however, that a text literal which is not the result of dynamic resolution of a property placeholder is of zero practical value since @DisabledIf("true") is equivalent to @Disabled and @DisabledIf("false") is logically meaningless.
items.translation: 然而请注意，如果 `text literal` 并非属性占位符动态解析的结果，则其实际价值为零，因为 `@DisabledIf("true")` 等同于 `@Disabled`，而 `@DisabledIf("false")` 在逻辑上毫无意义。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations. For example, a custom @DisabledOnMac annotation can be created as follows.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。例如，可以按如下方式创建自定义的 `@DisabledOnMac` 注解。

items.source: Please note that @DisabledOnMac is meant only as an example of what is possible. If you have that exact use case, please use the built-in @DisabledOnOs(MAC) support in JUnit Jupiter.
items.translation: 请注意，@DisabledOnMac 仅作为可能性的示例。如果您有完全相同的用例，请使用 JUnit Jupiter 中内置的 @DisabledOnOs(MAC) 支持。

items.source: JUnit Jupiter also has a condition annotation named @DisabledIf. Thus, if you wish to use Spring's @DisabledIf support make sure you import the annotation type from the correct package.
items.translation: JUnit Jupiter 还有一个名为 `@DisabledIf` 的条件注解。因此，如果您希望使用 Spring 的 `@DisabledIf` 支持，请确保从正确的包中导入该注解类型。

items.source: For basic examples, see the Javadoc for expression().
items.translation: 对于基本示例，请参阅expression()的Javadoc。

items.source: Defaults to false so that test application contexts are not eagerly loaded unnecessarily. If an expression is based solely on system properties or environment variables or does not interact with beans in the test's application context, there is no need to load the context prematurely since doing so would be a waste of time if the test ends up being disabled.
items.translation: 默认为 `false`，以避免不必要地急切加载测试应用程序上下文。如果表达式仅基于系统属性或环境变量，或者不与测试的应用程序上下文中的 Bean 交互，则无需过早加载该上下文，因为如果测试最终被禁用，这样做将是浪费时间。

items.source:
When applied at the class level, all test methods within that class
are automatically disabled as well.
items.translation: 当在类级别应用时，该类中的所有测试方法也会自动禁用。

items.source: Expressions can be any of the following.
items.translation: 表达式可以是以下任意一种。

items.source: Whether the ApplicationContext associated with the current test should be eagerly loaded in order to evaluate the expression().
items.translation: 当前测试关联的 `ApplicationContext` 是否应被急切加载，以评估 `expression()`。

items.source: The reason this test is disabled.

Placeholder for a property available in the Spring Environment — for example: 
@DisabledIf("${smoke.tests.disabled}")
items.translation:
Spring 中可用的属性的占位符，位于 Environment — 例如： 
@DisabledIf("${smoke.tests.disabled}")

items.source:
Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expression — for example: 
@DisabledIf("#{systemProperties['os.name'].toLowerCase().contains('mac')}")
items.translation:
Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 表达式——例如： 
@DisabledIf("#{systemProperties['os.name'].toLowerCase().contains('mac')}")

items.source: The expression that will be evaluated to determine if the annotated test class or test method is disabled.
items.translation: 将被求值以确定是否禁用已注解的测试类或测试方法的表达式。
